sampling_method: Four examples selected without replacement for every grid location; seed is SeedSequence([42, row_major_grid_index]).
noise_explanation: Each grid point measures actual error on four newly selected training examples. Changing examples between neighboring points creates most of the jaggedness; this is a noisy error estimate, not proof that the full-data error surface is jagged.
method: Two fixed patterns of changes to the saved final weights; biases unchanged. Each neuron receives changes scaled to its saved incoming weights. No training, smoothing, added heights, or invented noise.
